capture: Chromium on macOS; 1440x1000, 390x844 and 320x568 browser viewports. Not physical-device or visitor testing. Random source seed 0.13 for repeatable frames.
verification: 15 focused Chromium tests passed serially against the static preview. Covers native horizontal wheel scrolling, alternate random start, complete spotlight pool, navigation and history, timeline scroll and date selection, viewer return focus, gallery, save, share and real JPEG/ZIP downloads. After adding initial-header visibility assertions and the entry capture, both affected desktop and phone journeys passed again (2 tests, 4.1s). No implementation source changed after the full run.
